responsibility: Defines the RISC-V machine-description patterns for fences and atomic load/store operations under the standard RVWMO memory model when Ztso is not active. It selects the appropriate `fence` or `fence.tso` sequences based on GCC memmodel arguments and emits conservative acquire, release, acq_rel, and seq_cst encodings for plain atomic loads and stores, complementing the broader atomic support in sync.md with the weak-memory-specific forms.
